_meta.description: Best price on a fitted demand curve: a compose `fits` entry regresses weekly sales on price by OLS ONCE, and an `optimize` block maximises profit (price - params.cost) * demand over price in [8, 40], reading the intercept and slope with coef() so nothing is copied by hand. The response carries `optimizations`: the profit-maximising price (value), its marginal (about zero at an interior optimum), converged and starts_agreeing (how many of the 8 seeded starts reached it). Change params.cost to see the price move; tighten `tolerance` when the price itself must be exact.
_meta.name: compose-price-optimize
